CheckTitle: CloudFront Distributions not using a WAF web ACL
Description: CloudFront Distributions are not using a Web Application Firewall (WAF) web ACL.
Risk: CloudFront distributions are left vulnerable to various web-based attacks such as SQL injection, cross-site scripting (XSS), and DDoS attacks

Recommendation.Text: Use WAF web ACL to protect CloudFront Distributions against common web-based attacks.
